input.command:
python3 -c "
from miniconf.loader import load
print(load('examples/service.conf').as_dict())"
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -3
mkdir -p _t/sub && printf 'a=1\n@include sub/b.conf\n' > _t/a.conf && printf 'x=1\n@include ../a.conf\n' > _t/sub/b.conf && printf '@include nope.conf\n' > _t/m.conf
for f in a m; do python3 -c "
from miniconf.loader import load
try: load('_t/$f.conf')
except Exception as e: print(type(e).__name__, e)"; done; rm -rf _t
input.description: Test example, suite, cycle and missing
